hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path') or d.get('tool_response',{}).get('filePath') or '')" | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" == *.md ]]; then ROOT=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [[ -n "$ROOT" && -x "$ROOT/scripts/check-private-data.sh" ]]; then OUT_RAW=$(bash "$ROOT/scripts/check-private-data.sh" 2>&1); CODE=$?; if [[ $CODE -ne 0 ]]; then OUT=$(printf '%s' "$OUT_RAW" | sed -E 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g'); python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.dumps({'decision':'block','reason':sys.argv[1]}))" "$OUT"; fi; fi; fi; }
hooks.statusMessage: Scanning edited markdown for private data...
